headline: Insulet (PODD) Stock Looks Undervalued As The Market Stays Cautious
summary: Insulet stock has fallen sharply over the past year, yet both its Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and market multiples currently point to the shares trading below what the underlying business may be worth. Over the past 12 months, Insulet has declined 54.1%, which means the market has already priced in a lot of pessimism.
